spans.s:
The affix अ is also added to the word अमावास्या in the sense of 'born therein'.

Terms: अ

From this forward as far as the sūtra ब्रह्मणस्त्वः ५.१.१३६, the affixes त्व and तल् bear the rule.

Terms: त्व and तल्

आ and इ are optionally substituted for the final of the अङ्ग (stem) of हा (जुहोत्यादिगणः (3rd Conjugation)) before the Imperative ending हि।

Terms: कित् and ङित्
